title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
summary_raw: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
summary_raw: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, up to an unreleased model beyond the current generation. title: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
summary_raw: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters.
